verified: edh-d-99 review (Commander coordinator D, group graveyard-exile-cast; EDHREC rank 5,253), by hand against the Oracle text and the Scryfall rulings of 2018-03-16: one search by you of your library and your graveyard together (allZones, no choice of zones) for exactly five cards of any kind (min 5, max 5: no stated quality, so the five must be found, or every card when fewer, CR 701.23b, 701.23d), every other card of your library and graveyard exiled (each card you own in either zone that is not one of the found cards), the found cards put on top of your library in the order you choose (CR 401.4), then you lose half your life rounded up (template eff.edhd99.search.libraryAndGraveyard.exactly.exileRest.chosenOnTop, the one card that prints the wording: 6.9 deviation; eff.edhn3.ownLife.half.roundedUp; CR 701.23a, 608.2c, 119.3); no shuffle (none printed)

edh-d-99 review (Commander coordinator D, group graveyard-exile-cast; EDHREC rank 5,860), by hand against the Oracle text and the Scryfall rulings of 2023-02-04: flying, vigilance, toxic 2 unchanged; the corrupted end-step trigger (yours) goes through each opponent in turn order and, for each who has three or more poison counters as it resolves (CR 122.1f), exiles the top card of that player's library face down (CR 406.3); the cards exiled that way are one group that you look at (CR 701.20e) and may play for as long as each remains exiled, spending mana as though it were mana of any color to cast them (permit play, you fixed as the ability resolves, duration remainsExiled, anyManaColor; CR 601.3, 609.4b, 400.7: a card cast leaves exile and the permit with it); the permit is a resolved effect, so it lasts after Ixhel leaves the battlefield and never moves to a new controller (rulings) (template eff.edhd99.eachOpp.poisonAtLeast.exileTopFaceDown.lookPlay.anyColor, the one card that prints the wording: 6.9 deviation; trg.at, kw.line)

edh-d-99 review (Commander coordinator D, group graveyard-exile-cast; EDHREC rank 6,640), by hand against the Oracle text and the Scryfall ruling of 2023-05-12: the enters trigger has no targets and no modes; as it resolves you may pay {G} up to three times (pay upTo 3: you choose 0 to 3, CR 118.12, 608.2d); when you paid one or more times a reflexive trigger (CR 603.12) chooses up to that many of the three modes (min 0, max the times paid) and their targets as it is put on the stack: destroy target artifact or enchantment, exile target player's graveyard, you gain 4 life (reflexive header read by parser/lower/ability.ts#reflexiveHeader, as std-combat-2's "When you do, choose up to that many"; eff.stdcombat2.mayPay.upToTimes, eff.destroy, eff.t6.exile.graveyard.player, eff.gainlife; render family when-you-pay-up-to-times)

edh-d-99 review (Commander coordinator D, group graveyard-exile-cast; EDHREC rank 7,301), by hand against the Oracle text: at the beginning of your upkeep, for each opponent in turn order (forEach over the opponents, CR 101.4), you reveal the top card of your library (CR 701.20a), that opponent (the player of the run) may pay life equal to that card's mana value (a player who has less life cannot pay, CR 119.4; mana value CR 202.3); if they paid the card is exiled, otherwise it is put into your hand; the next run reveals the new top card (template eff.edhd99.repeat.eachOpp.revealTop.mayPayLifeMv.exileElseHand, the one card that prints the wording: 6.9 deviation; trg.at)

edh-d-99 review (Commander coordinator D, group graveyard-exile-cast; EDHREC rank 7,454), by hand against the Oracle text and the Scryfall rulings of 2022-04-29: choose one; (1) the target opponent sacrifices one creature or planeswalker they control whose mana value is at least that of every creature and planeswalker they control (they choose among a tie; CR 701.21a, 202.3, 608.2d; render family sacrifice-greatest-mv-creature-or-planeswalker), eff.sacrifice.choice; (2) the top three cards of your library are exiled and you may play them until your next end step (permit play, normal timing and costs, CR 611.2a, 601.3; eff.exile, eff.e29.permit.play.group.durFirst); (3) exile target player's graveyard (eff.t6.exile.graveyard.player)

edh-d-99 review (Commander coordinator D, group graveyard-exile-cast; EDHREC rank 7,772), by hand against the Oracle text and the Scryfall rulings of 2020-11-10: {T}: the active player ("the player whose turn it is", CR 102.1; parser/holes/player.ts W_ACTIVE, family player-whose-turn-it-is) may end the turn: a may of that player, not of Obeka's controller, whose yes ends the turn (endTurn: triggers waiting cease to exist, every object on the stack is exiled, then straight to the cleanup step, CR 724.1a-f); the reminder text is claimed as reminder (template eff.edhd99.activePlayer.mayEndTheTurn, the one card that prints the wording: 6.9 deviation)

edh-d-99 review (Commander coordinator D, group graveyard-exile-cast; EDHREC rank 8,271), by hand against the Oracle text and the Scryfall rulings of 2024-06-07: you may reveal it from your opening hand (pregame reveal, CR 103.6, 103.6b; each revealed copy its own); if you do, a delayed trigger at the beginning of your first upkeep (your next upkeep from the pre-game, CR 603.7a) looks at the top four cards of your library, lets you keep up to one of them on top, and exiles the rest of those four (CR 701.20e, 401.4, 406.1) (template sta.edhd99.pregame.reveal.firstUpkeep.lookPutBackExileRest, the one card that prints the wording: 6.9 deviation; the multi-sentence delayed body edh-d-32's templates could not read); "When you cast this spell, exile target permanent that's one or more colors" unchanged (trg.when, eff.exile; the trigger resolves first, ruling)

edh-d-99 review (Commander coordinator D, group graveyard-exile-cast; EDHREC rank 9,186), by hand against the Oracle text and the Scryfall rulings of 2021-02-05: chapter I: each player mills four cards (eff.mill), then for each graveyard (each player in turn order) you may choose none or one creature or planeswalker card in it, a milled one or one already there, no targets; the chosen cards are exiled and linked to this Saga (link exiled, CR 607.2a) (eff.edhd99.mayExile.oneCard.fromEachGraveyard, eff.stdfra.then.effects); chapters II and III: until end of turn you may cast spells from among the cards exiled with this Saga, spending mana as though it were mana of any color (a resolved cast permission locked to the linked cards as it begins, normal timing, CR 601.3, 609.4b, 611.2a; a card cast becomes a new object and is no longer exiled with it, CR 400.7) (eff.edhd99.dur.castFromAmongExiledWithSelf.anyColor; both templates on the one card that prints the wording: 6.9 deviation)

edh-d-99 review (Commander coordinator D, group graveyard-exile-cast; EDHREC rank 9,575), by hand against the Oracle text and the Scryfall rulings of 2024-07-05: at the beginning of combat on your turn, for each of the eleven keywords in printed order (flying, then the list, lower/same-for.ts once per keyword), if a creature card in your graveyard has that keyword as the ability resolves (exists: a creature card you own in your graveyard with it, CR 404.1, 702.1), the creatures you control then gain it until end of turn (the set fixed as it resolves, CR 611.2c); hexproof shares the variants the cards have (hexproof from white, not plain hexproof: likeAmong, ruling) (eff.trek3.grant.each.ifCond, eff.edhcb5.sameIsTrueFor, trg.at; render family graveyard-card-has-keyword)

edh-d-99 review (Commander coordinator D, group graveyard-exile-cast; EDHREC rank 9,993), by hand against the Oracle text and the Scryfall rulings of 2023-06-16: a legendary instant (cast only while you control a legendary creature or planeswalker, CR 205.4e; the reminder text claimed as reminder); destroy target creature (eff.destroy); then if that creature's controller (as it last existed, CR 608.2h) has more than four cards in hand, that player chooses and exiles cards from their hand equal to the difference, down to four (min and max the hand size less four, read as it resolves; CR 402.1, 406.1) (template eff.edhd99.ifHandMoreThan.exileTheDifference, the one card that prints the wording: 6.9 deviation)
